defs.def: to stop and hold a moving object, especially in your hands 接住；截住；拦住

ex.s: Henry Tyler made the catch of the year on the weekend.
ex.t: Henry Tyler上周末接住了年度最佳球。

ex.s: “I was turning the page to get ready for the next page, but the draft wind from the turn caused the spare pages to fall off the stand,” Mr Titterton said, “Luckily I was able to catch them and put them back.”
ex.t: “我正翻页准备下一页，但翻页带起的气流把备用的谱子从谱架上吹掉了，”蒂特顿先生说，“幸好我接住了它们并放回去。”

ex.s: The flat terraces catch the rainwater and prevent the soil from being washed away.
ex.t: 请找出每个单词后半部分中代表过去时态的部分。

ex.s: Catching falling objects.
ex.t: 接住掉落的物品。

defs.def: to hold a liquid when it falls 接（落下的液体）

ex.s: The only components required, though, are a 5'×5' sheet of clear or slightly milky plastic, six feet of plastic tube, and a container — perhaps just a drinking cup — to catch the water.
ex.t: 不过唯一需要的部件是一张5×5英尺的透明或微乳白塑料布、六英尺塑料管，以及一个容器——或许就一个喝水杯——来接水。

defs.def: to take hold of sb/sth 抓住；握住

ex.s: “Again, Daddy, again!” Jacky shouts as I throw him skywards and catch him on the way back down again.
ex.t: “再一次，爸爸，再一次！”杰基喊道，我把他扔向天空，在回来的路上又抓住了他。

defs.def: to capture a person or an animal that tries or would try to escape 逮住；捕捉；捕获

ex.s: Try to make the hole in a damp area to increase the water catcher’s productivity.
ex.t: 尽量在潮湿处挖坑，以提高集水器的产量。

ex.s: One moment she seems to be laughing at me, but then again I catch a sense of sadness in her smile.
ex.t: 有一刻她好像在嘲笑我，但随后我又从她的微笑中捕捉到一丝悲伤。

ex.s: But soon I caught a few of his glances.
ex.t: 但很快我捕捉到他几道目光。

ex.s: Fourteen wolves were caught in Canada and transported to the park.
ex.t: 在加拿大捕获了14只狼并被运送到公园。

defs.def: to find or discover sb doing sth, especially sth wrong 当场发现（或发觉）
to be in time for a bus, train, plane, etc. and get on it 赶上（公共汽车、火车、飞机等）

ex.s: But when he looked to the side, he saw instantly that it wasn’t a dog at all, but a wolf, quickly catching up with him.
ex.t: 但当他看着侧面时，他立刻看到它根本不是一只狗，而是一只狼，很快赶上了他。

ex.s: One of his friends had stopped to make a bicycle repair, but they had encouraged Mac to carry on, and they would catch up with him soon.
ex.t: 他的一个朋友停下来修自行车，但他们鼓励麦克继续前进，说很快就会赶上他。

ex.s: You might have to wait longer than 24 hours to catch the next one.
ex.t: 你可能需要等待超过24小时才能赶上下一班。

ex.s: To catch up with her work.
ex.t: 为了赶上她的工作。

ex.s: He had to catch up with his study.
ex.t: 他不得不赶上他的学习。

ex.s: If we see the elderly trying to catch their planes but walking at a snail’s pace, we find a wheelchair for them immediately.
ex.t: 如果我们看到老人试图赶飞机却以蜗牛般的速度行走，我们会立刻为他们找来轮椅。

defs.def: to be in time to do sth, talk to sb, etc. 及时做（或谈等）
to see or hear sth; to attend sth 看见；听到；出席；参加
to happen unexpectedly and put sb in a difficult situation 突然遭受
to get an illness 得病；染疾

ex.s: If we drink dirty water, we can catch diseases from the bacteria and become ill.
ex.t: 如果我们喝了脏水，可能会因细菌感染疾病而生病。

defs.def: to become stuck in or on sth; to make sth become stuck （被）钩住，夹住，绊住

ex.s: Don’t get caught making an embarrassing mistake at a restaurant
ex.t: 别在餐厅犯了尴尬的错误还被抓个正着

ex.s: catch sight ofB. make room for
ex.t: 看到 B. 为……腾出空间

defs.def: to hit sb/sth 击中；打
to notice sth only for a moment 察觉；瞥见
to hear or understand sth 听清楚；领会
if sth catches your interest, etc., you notice it and feel interested in it 引起，激发（兴趣、想像、注意等）

ex.s: Suddenly, a movement outside caught his eye.
ex.t: 突然，外面的一阵动静引起了他的注意。

ex.s: A noise at a window caught my attention, so I entered it.
ex.t: 窗户旁的响动引起了我的注意，于是我走了进去。

defs.def: to show or describe sth accurately 逼真再现；准确描绘
if sth catches the light or the light catches it, the light shines on it and makes it shine too （光）照射；受到（光的）照射

ex.s: This makes our body suffer and we will catch other diseases.
ex.t: 这会让我们的身体受苦，我们会染上其他疾病。

defs.def: if you catch the sun, you become red or brown because of spending time in the sun 晒黑；晒红；晒成棕色

ex.s: For instance, we may have a tendency to catch a cold easily.
ex.t: 例如，我们可能有容易感冒的倾向。

ex.s: Study the 19th century England, and you might catch a glimpse of Charles Dickens' Oliver Twist.
ex.t: 研究19世纪的英格兰，你或许能一窥查尔斯·狄更斯的《雾都孤儿》。

ex.s: Watch surfers who catch the waves- and maybe even give it a go yourself!
ex.t: 看看冲浪者如何追浪——说不定你自己也去试一把！

ex.s: Cooking together gives us a chance to relax and catch up on each other’s days.
ex.t: 一起做饭给了我们放松、聊聊彼此近况的机会。

defs.def: to begin to burn 烧着；着（火）
to make a player unable to continue batting by catching the ball they have hit before it touches the ground （在球落地前）接住球

ex.s: “I am pleasantly surprised, because I am always looking for where to plug it in,” Espinoza said before catching the subway in a working-class area of southern Barcelona.
ex.t: “我感到惊喜，因为我一直在找哪里能给车充电，”Espinoza在南巴塞罗那一个工人阶层社区赶地铁前说道。

ex.s: He pulled in front of it as the wolf was catching up fast, just a dozen yards away now.
ex.t: 他冲到那辆车前面，这时狼正在快速逼近，只有十几码远了。

defs.def: to stop breathing for a moment because of fear, shock, etc. （由于恐惧、震惊等）屏息，屏气
to breathe normally again after running or doing some tiring exercise （跑或激烈运动后）喘口气
to surprise sb and put them in a difficult position 使突陷困境
to show that sb does not know much or is doing sth wrong 抓住某人的短处；指出无知；指出过失

ex.s: What does the underlined phrase “the water catcher” in paragraph 2 refer to?
ex.t: 第2段中划线的短语“the water catcher”指的是什么？

defs.def: to spend extra time doing sth because you have not done it earlier 补做（未做的事）；赶做；补上
to find out about things that have happened 了解（已发生的事情）

ex.s: "We feel that we don't know the central character well enough" was the criticism he received on his manuscript for The Catcher in the Rye.
ex.t: “我们觉得我们对中心人物了解得不够”是他收到的关于《麦田里的守望者》手稿的批评。

defs.def: to reach sb who is ahead by going faster 赶上，追上（某人）

ex.s: He knew that zxxk once he hit the hill, he’d be easy caught up and the wolf’s teeth would be tearing into his flesh.
ex.t: 他知道一旦上了坡，他就很容易被追上，狼的牙齿将会撕咬进他的肉里。

defs.def: to reach the same level or standard as sb who was better or more advanced 赶上，达到（某水平）
to finally start to cause problems for sb after they have managed to avoid this for some time 产生（曾设法避免的）问题
if the police or authorities catch up with sb, they find and punish them after some time 终于查到某人头上
an act of catching sth, for example a ball 接（球等）
the total amount of things that are caught 总捕获量

ex.s: She caught a bad cold.
ex.t: 她得了重感冒。

ex.s: Then she caught the smell of burning.
ex.t: 平底锅里的那片面包也变黑了。

ex.s: Then she caught the smell of burning.
ex.t: 平底锅里的那片面包也变黑了。

ex.s: People quickly caught on.
ex.t: 人们很快就明白了规则。

defs.def: a device used for fastening sth 扣拴物；扣件
a hidden difficulty or disadvantage 隐藏的困难；暗藏的不利因素
a child's game in which two people throw a ball to each other （儿童）传接球游戏
a person that other people see as a good person to marry, employ, etc. 理想的对象；意中人；雇用的好对象；看中的人
